claim: The V7 internal-analysis deck may show the stored gender labels in aggregate buckets that meet the minimum cohort rule.
population: Active regular, non-RF360 employees across the six monthly snapshots ending 2026-08-23.
grain: Stored gender label across de-duplicated employee-snapshot exposure.
acceptance_rule: Every displayed stored label must be nonempty, have at least 30 distinct employees, and be observed in all six snapshots.
limitations: The existing Gender slide retains its frozen distribution and attrition values; this evidence validates the stored-label disclosure only.
No employee rows, identifiers, names, or individual values are included.
